lines.zh: 比迪丽踩着轻快的步子逼近
lines.en: Videl closes in with light, brisk steps.

lines.zh: 她抬手护在面前，随时能挡
lines.en: Her guard stays up, ready to block.

lines.zh: 她的马尾随动作左右摆
lines.en: Her ponytail swings with each move.

lines.zh: 她绕着你走，脚步不重
lines.en: She circles with a light tread.

lines.zh: 她忽然加快，抢了个角度
lines.en: She speeds up and takes an angle.

lines.zh: 她的白靴踩过草地很稳
lines.en: Her white boots plant firmly on grass.

lines.zh: 她一点点缩短距离
lines.en: She shortens the gap by degrees.

lines.zh: 她压低重心，像要起跳
lines.en: She sinks low as if to spring.

lines.zh: 她的呼吸控制得很好
lines.en: Her breathing is carefully controlled.

lines.zh: 她走位时几乎不留空隙
lines.en: She leaves almost no opening as she moves.

lines.zh: 她从你侧面绕了半圈
lines.en: She swings half around your side.

lines.zh: 她退了一步，重新找节奏
lines.en: She steps back to find her rhythm.

lines.zh: 比迪丽活动手腕，做准备
lines.en: Videl works her wrists, getting ready.

lines.zh: 她把护腕紧了紧
lines.en: She tightens her wrist wraps.

lines.zh: 她原地跳了两下
lines.en: She bounces on her toes twice.

lines.zh: 她吐出一口气，肩放松
lines.en: She exhales and drops her shoulders.

lines.zh: 她扫了眼地形，记住了位置
lines.en: She scans the ground and notes it.

lines.zh: 她把额前的碎发拨到耳后
lines.en: She tucks stray hair behind her ear.

lines.zh: 她握拳，又松开
lines.en: She makes a fist, then releases it.

lines.zh: 她的目光在找你的破绽
lines.en: Her eyes are hunting a weakness.

lines.zh: 她侧身站着，保持灵活
lines.en: She stands side-on, staying mobile.

lines.zh: 她轻轻吸了口气
lines.en: She takes a quiet breath.

lines.zh: 她脚尖点地，试着弹性
lines.en: She taps the ground, testing the surface.

lines.zh: 她盯着你，眼里全是干劲
lines.en: She watches you, all determination.

lines.zh: 她把外套的扣子扣好
lines.en: She fastens her jacket buttons.

lines.zh: 她看起来很有精神
lines.en: She looks thoroughly awake.

lines.zh: 比迪丽抬头正对上你
lines.en: Videl lifts her head to meet you.

lines.zh: 她上下打量，评估你的体格
lines.en: She sizes up your build.

lines.zh: 她抬高下巴，一点不让
lines.en: Her chin lifts; she does not yield.

lines.zh: 她把你和见过的对手比了比
lines.en: She compares you to foes she has faced.

lines.zh: 她眯起眼睛，像在算距离
lines.en: She narrows her eyes, measuring range.

lines.zh: 她往前走半步，很有气势
lines.en: She steps in with real presence.

lines.zh: 她的表情从警戒变成好奇
lines.en: Her guard gives way to curiosity.

lines.zh: 她打量完，微微点头
lines.en: Having looked, she gives a small nod.

lines.zh: 她把手放在腰侧，等你
lines.en: She rests a hand at her hip and waits.

lines.zh: 她挑眉，像在挑衅
lines.en: One brow lifts, inviting the challenge.

lines.zh: 她的眼神很直接，没有躲闪
lines.en: Her gaze is direct and unflinching.

lines.zh: 她对你说了句什么，语气利落
lines.en: She says something, crisp and sure.

lines.zh: 她把你从头看到脚，又看回来
lines.en: Her eyes travel down and back up.

lines.zh: 她笑了一下，带着挑战
lines.en: She smiles, and it is a challenge.

lines.zh: 她侧身，摆出请的姿势
lines.en: She turns side-on and beckons.

lines.zh: 她在等你先出手
lines.en: She waits for you to start.

lines.zh: 她把拳套往上提了提
lines.en: She pulls her gloves up.

lines.zh: 她点头，接受了这场较量
lines.en: She nods, accepting the contest.

lines.zh: 比迪丽挨了一下，退了半步
lines.en: Videl takes it and gives half a step.

lines.zh: 她咬牙，把架势重新立住
lines.en: She grits her teeth and re-sets her guard.

lines.zh: 她抬手擦掉嘴角的血
lines.en: She wipes blood from her lip.

lines.zh: 她的呼吸乱了一拍，很快稳住
lines.en: Her breath slips a beat, then steadies.

lines.zh: 她退开，重新估算距离
lines.en: She backs off and regauges the range.

lines.zh: 她甩了甩被打中的手臂
lines.en: She shakes out the arm that was hit.

lines.zh: 她吸了口气，眼里更倔了
lines.en: She breathes in, her look turning stubborn.

lines.zh: 她的护腕被蹭歪了
lines.en: Her wrist wrap is knocked askew.

lines.zh: 她半跪了一下，立刻起来
lines.en: She drops to one knee and rises at once.

lines.zh: 她低声对自己说了句什么
lines.en: She mutters something to herself.

lines.zh: 比迪丽看了一眼你手里的东西
lines.en: Videl glances at what you hold.

lines.zh: 她摇头，示意自己不吃这套
lines.en: She shakes her head; not falling for that.

lines.zh: 她把东西接过去，道了声谢
lines.en: She takes it and thanks you.

lines.zh: 她一边吃一边盯着你
lines.en: She eats while keeping an eye on you.

lines.zh: 她摆了摆手，让你收起来
lines.en: She waves for you to put it away.

lines.zh: 她笑你拿这个来收买她
lines.en: She laughs that you would try to buy her.

lines.zh: 她把食物分了一半给你
lines.en: She splits the food and offers half.

lines.zh: 她吃得很快，像在赶时间
lines.en: She eats fast, as if short on time.

lines.zh: 她把包装塞回你手里
lines.en: She pushes the wrapper back at you.

lines.zh: 她咽下最后一口，站直了
lines.en: She swallows the last bite and straightens.

lines.zh: 你撞上比迪丽，她站得极稳
lines.en: You hit Videl and she holds her ground.

lines.zh: 她借力侧身，把你让过去
lines.en: She rolls with it and lets you pass.

lines.zh: 她抬手挡了一下，动作利落
lines.en: A crisp block catches the impact.

lines.zh: 她被撞得退了半步，又回来
lines.en: She gives half a step, then returns.

lines.zh: 她的肩一顶，你反而退了
lines.en: Her shoulder check pushes you back.

lines.zh: 她的靴底在土上划了一下
lines.en: Her boot scrapes across the dirt.

lines.zh: 她低头看你有没有事
lines.en: She looks down to check on you.

lines.zh: 她侧步让开，很客气
lines.en: She steps aside politely.

lines.zh: 她的马尾扫过你的脸
lines.en: Her ponytail whips across your face.

lines.zh: 她稳住身形，重新举手
lines.en: She steadies and raises her guard again.

lines.zh: 比迪丽和同伴对了个眼神
lines.en: Videl shares a look with her partner.

lines.zh: 两人同时摆出架势
lines.en: Both drop into stance together.

lines.zh: 她抬手替对方拨正护腕
lines.en: She adjusts her partner's wrist guard.

lines.zh: 她们并肩移动，脚步一致
lines.en: They move abreast in matching steps.

lines.zh: 她退了半步，把正面让出
lines.en: She gives half a step to let her partner lead.

lines.zh: 她们背靠背，各看一边
lines.en: Back to back, each watches a side.

lines.zh: 她笑着撞了下对方的肩
lines.en: She bumps her partner's shoulder, grinning.

lines.zh: 她们的呼吸很快对齐了
lines.en: Their breathing aligns quickly.

lines.zh: 她说了一句，对方点了头
lines.en: She speaks; her partner nods.

lines.zh: 这份默契是靠练出来的
lines.en: This understanding was earned in training.

lines.zh: 比迪丽利落地捡起东西
lines.en: Videl picks it up efficiently.

lines.zh: 她翻看了一下，收进口袋
lines.en: She turns it over and pockets it.

lines.zh: 她抛起来接住，笑了
lines.en: She flips it, catches it, and grins.

lines.zh: 她把不用的还给你
lines.en: What she does not need, she returns.

lines.zh: 她弯下腰，马尾滑到前面
lines.en: She bends; her ponytail slides forward.

lines.zh: 她一边捡一边看你的方向
lines.en: She keeps her eyes your way as she gathers.

lines.zh: 她把东西码得整整齐齐
lines.en: She sets the items in a neat row.

lines.zh: 她用靴尖把东西挑起来
lines.en: She flicks it up with her boot tip.

lines.zh: 她拾起后立刻站直
lines.en: She is upright again at once.

lines.zh: 她抱着东西，退到一边
lines.en: She carries it off to one side.

lines.zh: 比迪丽的架势一下收紧了
lines.en: Videl's stance snaps tight.

lines.zh: 她抬手，掌心聚起白光
lines.en: A small white light gathers in her palm.

lines.zh: 她的气息往前一压
lines.en: Her presence presses forward.

lines.zh: 她压低身体，重心前移
lines.en: She sinks and shifts her weight forward.

lines.zh: 她的目光钉住你的肩
lines.en: Her eyes fix on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 她侧身，把拳架到了下巴前
lines.en: She turns side-on, fist to chin.

lines.zh: 我没有气功，只靠这双脚追上你。
lines.en: No ki blasts; these two feet will catch you.

lines.zh: 她的呼吸变得极稳
lines.en: Her breathing goes very steady.

lines.zh: 她轻声说了句“来吧”
lines.en: She murmurs: come on.

lines.zh: 她的脚尖已经开始挪动
lines.en: Her toes have already started moving.

lines.zh: 她的眼神变得专注
lines.en: Her eyes sharpen with focus.

lines.zh: 她决定先动手了
lines.en: She decides to move first.

lines.zh: 她的手心那点光越来越亮
lines.en: The light in her palm brightens.

lines.zh: 她把外套下摆甩到身后
lines.en: She flips her jacket hem back.

lines.zh: 她深吸一口气，压住节奏
lines.en: She breathes deep to hold the tempo.

lines.zh: 她不再等了
lines.en: She is done waiting.

lines.zh: 比迪丽绕着你快步移动
lines.en: Videl moves quickly around you.

lines.zh: 她试着用假动作骗你
lines.en: She tests a feint on you.

lines.zh: 她的拳路很短，出手很快
lines.en: Her punches are short and fast.

lines.zh: 她换了个角度再逼近
lines.en: She switches angles and presses again.

lines.zh: 她抬手护脸，脚在找位置
lines.en: Guard up, her feet hunt for position.

lines.zh: 她忽然后撤，拉开距离
lines.en: She hops back to reset the range.

lines.zh: 她侧头看你的重心在哪
lines.en: She checks where your weight sits.

lines.zh: 她的呼吸一点没乱
lines.en: Her breathing has not slipped at all.

lines.zh: 她在等一个明确的机会
lines.en: She waits for one clean opening.

lines.zh: 她的掌心又亮了一下
lines.en: Her palm flickers with light.

lines.zh: 她把你往空地上引
lines.en: She draws you onto open ground.

lines.zh: 她压低声音，咬着牙
lines.en: She mutters through her teeth.

lines.zh: 她开始加速，脚步更密
lines.en: Her steps quicken and crowd in.

lines.zh: 她退半步是为了进来
lines.en: The half step back is to come in.

lines.zh: 她盯着你的手肘
lines.en: Her eyes lock on your elbows.

lines.zh: 她轻轻跳了一下，调整节奏
lines.en: A small hop resets her rhythm.

lines.zh: 她准备把节奏抢过去
lines.en: She is about to take the tempo.

lines.zh: 她的拳套已经抬到脸侧
lines.en: Her glove is up beside her cheek.

lines.zh: 比迪丽一记直拳打在你胸口
lines.en: Videl's straight punch hits your chest.

lines.zh: 她连出两拳，收得极快
lines.en: Two fast punches, pulled back fast.

lines.zh: 她一脚扫向你的小腿
lines.en: A low kick sweeps at your shin.

lines.zh: 她转身加了记肘击
lines.en: Her turn drives an elbow in.

lines.zh: 她抬手格开你的反击
lines.en: She parries your counter.

lines.zh: 她用掌根推你的下巴
lines.en: A palm heel snaps at your jaw.

lines.zh: 她打一下就退，毫不恋战
lines.en: She strikes once and backs off.

lines.zh: 她试探性地点了你一拳
lines.en: A light testing jab.

lines.zh: 她借你前冲的力摔了你
lines.en: She uses your forward rush to throw you.

lines.zh: 她跳起来，膝盖撞在你侧胸
lines.en: She leaps, knee into your side.

lines.zh: 她的拳带着一点气功的光
lines.en: Her fist carries a hint of ki.

lines.zh: 她打空，立刻收手护脸
lines.en: The miss becomes an immediate guard.

lines.zh: 她连着两次假动作才真打
lines.en: Two feints, then the real strike.

lines.zh: 她出手后还在调整呼吸
lines.en: She adjusts her breathing even as she strikes.

lines.zh: 这一下她用了真力
lines.en: That one had real force behind it.

lines.zh: 她退开半步，重新举手
lines.en: She backs half a step and raises her guard.

lines.zh: 比迪丽从树后走出来
lines.en: Videl walks out from behind a tree.

lines.zh: 她轻巧落地，没有声响
lines.en: She lands lightly, without a sound.

lines.zh: 她抬手扫了扫衣服上的灰
lines.en: She brushes dust off her clothes.

lines.zh: 她把马尾重新扎紧
lines.en: She reties her ponytail tight.

lines.zh: 她一站定就抱起了架势
lines.en: She settles straight into a stance.

lines.zh: 她环视一圈，确认了场地
lines.en: She scans the area, confirming the ground.

lines.zh: 她把护腕拉正
lines.en: She straightens her wrist wraps.

lines.zh: 她跳了两下，热身
lines.en: She hops twice to warm up.

lines.zh: 她看见你，先笑了一下
lines.en: She spots you and smiles first.

lines.zh: 她远远地就抬起了手
lines.en: She raises a hand from a distance.

lines.zh: 她踩着轻快的步子靠近
lines.en: She approaches with a brisk step.

lines.zh: 她的白靴踩得很干净
lines.en: Her white boots land clean.

lines.zh: 她把外套下摆理顺
lines.en: She smooths her jacket hem.

lines.zh: 她站定时，眼光很亮
lines.en: When she stops, her eyes are bright.

lines.zh: 她侧头看你，等你表态
lines.en: She tilts her head, waiting on you.

lines.zh: 她像是专程来找对手的
lines.en: She looks like she came looking for a fight.

lines.zh: 她把袖子往上挽了一截
lines.en: She pushes her sleeves up a notch.

lines.zh: 她从坡上轻快地跑下来
lines.en: She jogs lightly down the slope.

lines.zh: 火苗舔到袖子，她连忙拍打
lines.en: Flame catches her sleeve; she slaps it out.

lines.zh: 落地时她滚了一圈才起身
lines.en: She lands, rolls, and comes up.

lines.zh: 呛了水，她仰头拼命上浮
lines.en: She chokes and kicks hard for the surface.

lines.zh: 爆炸把她掀得连退数步
lines.en: The blast throws her back several steps.

lines.zh: 箭擦破她的手臂，她皱眉
lines.en: An arrow grazes her arm; she winces.

lines.zh: 怪力侵入，她痛苦地弯了下腰
lines.en: Odd force hits; she folds at the waist.

lines.zh: 饿着打，她的拳软了半分
lines.en: Fighting hungry, her punches lose bite.

lines.zh: 雷击让她一下跪倒，又撑起来
lines.en: Lightning drops her to a knee; she rises.

lines.zh: 虚空拽她，她拼命往边上抓
lines.en: The void pulls; she claws for the edge.
